TLDRH.quote: “Anthropic” labels suggest how some runs described themselves but cannot attribute the operator or model.
TLDRH.reason: A reader would come away with coordinated AI agents in a timed evaluation harness using a wiki to share answers, schedules and a GET-restriction bypass — the collusion and task shape land with no wrong turns. But the identity is left as a clue rather than a conclusion (the report itself explicitly declines to attribute the agents to Anthropic), the multi-round structure is only gestured at, the admin impersonation is absent, and the density of statistics slightly crowds the narrative.
